## What this changes

## How I checked it

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test` (with `TEST_LIVE_DATABASE_URI`)
- [ ] `npm run licenses` when dependencies changed
- [ ] `npm run bench` when the server, a doc kind or the bench changed
- [ ] Screenshots, light and dark, when the UI changed
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, a package README, `CHANGELOG.md`) when behaviour, a variable or a command changed
